title: Reports hub (administrator packs)
intro: Administrators use the same Reports hub as managers, with access to deeper packs such as products and tax. Open a category, pick a report, set filters, then run or export.

sections.title: Administrator reports layout
steps: Categories on the left include Sales, Products, Operations, and more.
The middle column lists reports in the selected pack; the right panel holds filters.
sections.caption: Reports hub for administrator packs.

sections.title: Products pack
steps: Use Product mix summary or weekly mix for item performance.
Products hourly shows velocity by hour for staffing and prep planning.
sections.caption: Products report pack.

sections.title: Tax report filters
sections.intro: Tax sits under Sales. Administrators use it to reconcile collected tax by period.
steps: Set the date range and any venue filters.
Run the report for filing or audit checks.
sections.caption: Tax report filter panel.
